candidates.description: Circuit-constrained authenticated credential and membership relations, plus bound statement/context
candidates.benefit: Single composed verification circuit may cover membership, linkage and transcript constraints
risks: Circuit and credential signature compatibility unresolved
Trusted setup or proof-system assumptions must be disclosed

candidates.description: Prove authenticated signature statements and linked commitment predicates with compatible components
candidates.benefit: Potential reuse of existing credential signature and linkage construction profiles
risks: Proof-system interoperability across constituent components not established
Aggregating receipts is not equivalent to proving joint witness consistency
requires: Credential profile assumptions and rejection vectors

candidates.description: Explicitly verify several cryptographic subproofs and bind their shared statement, context and authenticated roots
candidates.benefit: Can isolate component assumptions and give earlier inspectable evidence
risks: Verifier orchestration can silently fail to enforce cross-proof witness equality
Transcript and context binding must cover every component
May not satisfy the single composed proof properties of record 010
requires: Formal equivalence mapping to every record-010 clause

gates.check: Disclosed statement and correlation scope map to the canonical record without oversharing
Actual proof and witness binding, voucher offline Clause 3, and transcript anti-replay verified
Status evidence, root authentication and observation/freshness assumptions explicit
Authority, community recognition and external credential/registry claims remain externally owned
Measured prover/verifier/transport characteristics with reproducible environment
Machine-readable vectors, externally owned profile constraints, and independent evidence gate explicit

selection_requirements: Every gate must have an attributable disposition and falsifiable evidence
Record 010 offline voucher path must execute cryptographically
False stronger-inference requests remain rejected by proof-claim framework
No unsupported Credential or Registry semantics are frozen
